title: Lumina: Ember's Awakening
brief: Original-IP platformer game (sub-genre: 2d-platformer). Capture the core mechanics and game-feel of "Rayman Legends" (critically acclaimed, 91%) — but with your OWN original name, theme, characters and art. Do NOT reference or reuse that title's IP. SIGNATURE MECHANIC for this genre: gravity + jump/coyote/dash feel + hazard traversal + goal. MUST SHIP COMPLETE: a working menu (title + difficulty + how-to + settings via FFG.Shell), the page control bar (fullscreen/mute/pause), a clear win AND lose state, readable HUD, and polished feel — it must play start-to-finish with no manual fixes.

M0.done_when: design doc written: core loop, verbs, scope, art direction, definition_of_done

M1.done_when: core loop genuinely playable in ONE level: structure+feel green, no crash

M2.done_when: every verb in the design doc implemented and survives the play-bot

M3.done_when: multiple levels + progression + a real difficulty curve; everything reachable

M4.done_when: menu + audio + game-feel/juice; vision fidelity high; zero crashes

M5.done_when: deep QA: structure+feel+fidelity+review all green across repeated playthroughs

design_doc.title: Lumina: Ember's Awakening
design_doc.core_loop: Guide Lumina, a sentient wisp of living light, through a decaying shadow-realm to reignite the Primordial Flames scattered across five corrupted biomes. Each level demands precise platforming through rhythm-synced environmental hazards—pulsing void-spikes, collapsing shadow platforms, and gravitational rifts—while collecting ember shards to unlock new movement abilities. The core satisfaction comes from chaining wall-runs, mid-air dashes, and glide-bursts to maintain flow state through increasingly complex gauntlets, culminating in a boss encounter where you must navigate attack patterns while racing against a darkness-creep timer.
verbs: wall-slide (reduced fall speed on vertical surfaces)
glide (hold jump at apex, slower descent)
design_doc.scope: IN: 5 handcrafted biomes (4 levels each + 1 boss = 25 levels total), 60-90 min first-playthrough, time-attack mode per level, 3 difficulty presets (Spark/Flame/Inferno affecting hazard speed + checkpoint density), accessibility options (toggle i-frames, adjust timers), persistent progress save. OUT: procedural generation, multiplayer, spoken dialogue (environmental storytelling only via background art + brief text cards), achievements/trophies, post-game content, level editor, multiple playable characters.
design_doc.art_direction: High-contrast luminescent aesthetic: Lumina renders as a radiant golden-white particle trail against deep indigo/obsidian backgrounds. Environments use a restricted palette (midnight blues #1a1a2e, corrupt purples #6a0572, toxic greens #16213e for hazards, warm amber/gold #ffa500 for collectibles and safe zones). All platforms have subtle pulse-glow edges. Parallax backgrounds feature silhouetted ruins and giant petrified fauna. Particle-heavy: every action leaves light streaks, dashes emit nova bursts, deaths scatter embers. UI uses clean sans-serif with glowing accents. Mood: melancholic beauty, Hollow Knight meets Ori's environmental storytelling but purely through color/light language.

milestone_plan.M1: Vertical slice (1 complete level, 60s duration): Run, jump, wall-jump, dash functional with tight physics tuning (jump arc feels floaty-but-responsive, dash snappy). 3 hazard types implemented (spikes, collapsing platforms, moving saw-blades). Title screen + HUD (ember count, timer) + win/lose states. FFG.Shell integration (difficulty select, pause, mute, fullscreen). Prove the core feel.
milestone_plan.M2: Core mechanics complete: All 9 verbs implemented and tuned. Physics locked (gravity 2400 px/s², jump force 850 px/s, dash 1600 px/s). 5 hazard archetypes (spikes, saws, void-zones, gravity-wells, timed-lasers) + checkpoint system. 3 biomes drafted (layouts only, placeholder art). Difficulty modifier system working (adjusts hazard speed ±30%, checkpoint spacing).
milestone_plan.M3: Content pass: All 25 levels built and playable end-to-end. Each biome introduces 1 new mechanic layer (Biome 2: moving platforms, Biome 3: gravity inversion zones, Biome 4: rhythm-synced barriers, Biome 5: boss arena with 3-phase pattern). Collectible placement tuned (80% shards required to unlock final boss). Time-attack par times set per level.
milestone_plan.M4: Polish and juice: Particle systems for all actions (dash trails, jump puffs, death bursts). Screen shake on dash/landing. Dynamic camera (slight lead on player movement direction). Audio integration (movement SFX, hazard hums, ambient drone, victory jingle). HUD animations (ember counter increments smoothly, timer flashes <10s remaining). Transition animations (level enter/exit fades). Settings persistence (volume, difficulty, progress save/load).
milestone_plan.M5: Ship-ready: Full QA pass on all 25 levels (no soft-locks, all checkpoints functional). How-to-play screen with animated GIF demos of each verb. Credits screen. Build optimization (target 60fps, <50MB bundle). Accessibility audit (colorblind-safe palette verified, input rebinding if time permits). Final tuning pass on difficulty curve (Inferno mode validated beatable by playtester). Deploy to itch.io + Newgrounds with gameplay trailer.

definition_of_done: Player can launch game, select difficulty, and complete all 25 levels from title screen to credits without manual intervention
All 9 movement verbs respond within 1 frame of input with tuned parameters (no floaty/sluggish feel)
Death states trigger immediately on hazard collision, respawn at last checkpoint within 0.8s, retry count tracked per level
Win state triggers on final boss defeat, displays completion time + total embers collected, unlocks time-attack mode
HUD permanently visible: ember count (current/total per level), timer (MM:SS.ms), death counter, no overlapping UI elements
FFG.Shell integration: pause menu accessible via ESC, settings persist across sessions (volume/difficulty), fullscreen toggle functional, mute affects all audio channels
All 5 biomes visually distinct (unique background parallax + hazard color themes), no placeholder art in shipped build
Accessibility: difficulty presets modify hazard speed (±30%) and checkpoint density (±50%), settings include separate music/SFX sliders
Performance: maintains 60fps on mid-tier hardware (2019 integrated GPU equivalent), load times <2s between levels
No game-breaking bugs: no soft-locks, no sequence breaks, all checkpoints save correctly, progress persists through browser refresh (localStorage)
How-to-play screen demonstrates all verbs with looping visual examples, accessible from title screen and pause menu
Audio: 15+ SFX cues (jump/land/dash/death/collect/checkpoint/win/lose), 2 music tracks minimum (menu + gameplay loop), all audio respects mute setting
